newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil govt, coffee exporters to meet April 24.
newsitem.headline: Brazil govt, coffee exporters to meet April 24.

text.p: Officials from Brazil's Coffee Exporters' Federation (FEBEC) will meet Mauricio Assis, head of the Industry and Commerce Ministry's primary commodities department, on April 24, FEBEC's president said.
The meeting, to take place at 1700 local/2000 GMT in Rio de Janeiro, will look at the progress of Brazilian coffee exports and market prospects, said Oswaldo Aranha.
Exporters hold regular meetings with Assis to discuss the flow of coffee onto the international market.

Aranha declined to comment on whether talks would also include any Brazilian proposals on market stabilisation plans from July 1997 amongst members of the Association of Coffee Producing Countries (ACPC).
The ACPC secretariat has asked members to send any suggestions to London ahead of a council session to be held on May 21.
